decisions.reason: The duration-based approval threshold and full-lesson requirement do not change caption color, font, effects, lettering, or position.
The source changes clip-duration approval and reiterates content completeness, not the clean-editing or effects rules.
The source does not change permitted source material or source-selection constraints.
The source's full-value-or-lesson effect is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY updating required_content_value; no additional update or removal is needed.
Requiring a complete lesson does not change the separate standard for selecting strong or impactful source moments.
The source does not discuss wind noise or any other audio-cleanup behavior.
The next-batch clip standard does not alter Lead Clipper assignment, training, compensation, or responsibilities.
The approval workflow remains unchanged; the new 45-second approval criterion is correctly owned by the atomic clip-duration Requirement rather than duplicated on the approval gate.
The source changes the criteria for approving the next batch, not the instructions for publishing clips after approval.
The source does not change the submission channel, folder configuration, batch size, deadline, or review-link workflow.
The source applies to the next production batch and does not modify the earlier clipper qualification process.
The number of required approved clips, quota period, counting rule, and daily cadence remain unchanged; the duration threshold is an upstream approval criterion.
